title: We replaced four cameras with one
idea: Design decision (ADR-0043): the chasing combat cameras spun with every sidestep (83 degrees over six sidesteps); Steady turned 6. Real Steady footage, the measured numbers, an old/new launch still, ends on a question.
feedback: Owner 2026-10-28: not so good. Stills cannot show the old camera spinning; options left open: animated 83 vs 6 degree dials, real old-camera footage from git, or an X dev-log.
